name: merchantos
description: MerchantOS — offline-first POS, billing, payments, khata. 100% self-hosted, zero third-party dependencies.

scripts.build:packages: for p in packages/*/; do (cd "$p" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build); done
scripts.build:api: cd api && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api
